fact: Car 12 was released into the path of Car 27.
offence: Breach of Article 34.14 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 12 was released into the path of Car 27. Car 27 had to brake and take avoiding action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 12 Unsafe Release
